{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Secondary Dexterity''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary_Weapon_Arcanes|Secondary Arcane]] that on melee kill increases secondary damage for 20 seconds and stacks up to 6 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[Melee Combo Counter]] duration.

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
! Total at 6 stacks
! Combo Duration
|-
| 0 || 10% || 60% || -
|-
| 1 || 20% || 120% || -
|-
| 2 || 30% || 180% || -
|-
| 3 || 40% || 240% || -
|-
| 4 || 50% || 300% || -
|-
| 5 || 60% || 360% || 7.5s
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}.
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
*Companions can also activate the melee kill condition if they are using a melee weapon such as Claws, Deconstructor or any of the Hound weapons.

==Tips==
*If players would rather prefer to focus on melee and not on shooting targets, they can opt to equip this Arcane and {{Arcane|Primary Dexterity}}, both at max rank, on their ranged weapons simply to provide their passive melee combo counter buffs that grant up to 15 seconds.
*When equipped on an [[Archgun]], the combo duration buff will still apply even if the archgun is never deployed, allowing for bonus combo duration without sacrificing your secondary weapon's Arcane slot.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32}}
;1. b) Holster Speed Buffs & Mod Changes

These changes to Ammo encourage swapping between weapons, so we’ve taken the opportunity to dramatically increase the swapping speed between Primary and Secondary. The real purpose of your Secondary weapon is for it to be a backup to your Primary, but with the holster speeds the way they were before that vision was not realized - until now! 

In light of the overall speed buff to holster speed, we have made the following changes to the mods and Arcanes that offered holster speed stat increases: 

'''''(All stats below are shown at max rank)'''''

Secondary Dexterity Arcane: 

*Removed their “+60% Holster Speed” bonus.

{{ver|30.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

*{{Arcane|Primary Dexterity}}, the primary equivalent.

'''Secondary Deadhead''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary_Weapon_Arcanes|Secondary Arcane]] that increases secondary weapon damage on weak point kill for 24 seconds and stacks up to 3 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot damage multiplier]] and reduces [[recoil]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==

! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
! Total at 3 stacks
! Headshot Multiplier
! Recoil

| 0 || 20% || 60% || - || -
|-
| 1 || 40% || 120% || - || -

|-
| 3 || 80% || 240% || - || -
|-
| 4 || 100% || 300% || - || -
|-
| 5 || 120% || 360% || +30% || -50%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}.
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
*Headshot bonus stacks additively with similar buffs, such as {{A|Prowl}}.
*Kills from some status procs on the target's head do '''not''' count as a weak point kill.
**{{D|Electricity}} and {{D|Gas}} procs are able to trigger the effect when aimed at the head however, as they are able to land headshots themselves.
*'Precision' refers to direct hit weak points (not AoE).

== Tips ==
* Can be used on weapons which normally have a 1.0x multiplier to headshots (such as the {{Weapon|Catchmoon}}) to give them a 1.3x headshot multiplier and actually provide a benefit.
* Since Electricity and Gas procs are able to independently land headshots, they benefit twice from the headshot multiplier bonus. Both of these procs will have 1.69x headshot damage from the bonus.

{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Secondary Merciless''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary_Weapon_Arcanes|Secondary Arcane]] that on kill increases secondary weapon damage for 4 seconds and stacks up to 12 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[reload speed]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
!Total at 12 stacks
! Reload Speed
|-
| 0 || 5% || 60% || -
|-
| 1 || 10% || 120%  || -
|-
| 2 || 15% || 180% || -
|-
| 3 || 20% || 240% || -
|-
| 4 || 25% || 300% || -
|-
| 5 || 30% || 360% || 30%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*'''Only''' weapon kills from the weapon with Secondary Merciless counts for stacking this effect.
**Status kills count if the killing status was applied by the weapon with Merciless. 
**Lingering effects that deal damage usually count.
**Alt-fire modes usually count.
*Stacks of the buff are not shared between different weapons that have Secondary Merciless equipped, such as secondary [[Exalted Weapons]] and [[Archgun|Archguns]].
**Individual weapons have their own stacks which are stored and updated independently of other stacks of Secondary Merciless. 
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
**After reaching the maximum 12 stacks, the buff will take 48 seconds to fully expire.
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}.

==Tips==
*Useful on weapons that can already kill groups of enemies quickly, such as most explosive weapons or weapons that chain between targets. Less useful on slow firing weapons that rely on status effects to kill their targets like single shot rifles.
*Can be compared to {{Arcane|Secondary Deadhead}}, which has an identical maximum damage bonus of 360%, but acquires stacks on [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] kills, requiring fewer total kills for upkeep, and which can last for a total of 72 seconds, rather than the 48 seconds of Merciless.
*Can be compared to {{Arcane|Cascadia Flare}}, which has a higher maximum damage bonus of 480% by stacking on {{D|Heat}} procs rather than kills, but expiring all at once on a much faster 10 second duration, compared to the 48 second duration of Merciless.

{{ver|30.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

***{{A|Avalanche}}  (10 {{D|Cold}} stacks)
**{{WF|Gauss}}' {{A|Thermal Sunder}} double cast ([[Helminth]] subsumable) or with {{A|Redline}} active  (10 {{D|Cold}} stacks)
**{{WF|Lavos}}'s {{A|Vial Rush}} ([[Helminth]] subsumable)  (3 {{D|Cold}} stacks on hit, plus pools that inflict 1 {{D|Cold}}  per second)
**{{Arcane|Melee Careen}} at Rank 5 (10 {{D|Cold}} stacks)

'''Secondary Outburst''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement|Secondary Arcane]] that consumes all melee combo multipliers to increase secondary weapon [[Critical Chance]] and [[Critical Damage]] upon swapping to a secondary weapon.

==Effect==

|-
![[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
!Bonus per Combo

!Bonus with [[Venka Prime|13x Combo]]

|1||+7%||+84%

| +117%

|3||+12%||+144%
| +156%
|-
|4||+16%||+192%
| +208%
|-
|5||+20%||+240%
| +260%
|-
|}

==Acquisition==
*May appear as a [[The Steel Path|Steel Path]] [[The Circuit|Circuit]] Tier 1, 3, 4, 6, or 7 reward on a weekly rotational basis.
*May be sold by [[Acrithis]] for 10 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp}}s on a daily rotational basis, requiring [[Drifter/Intrinsics|Drifter Intrinsics]] [[Drifter/Intrinsics/Opportunity|Opportunity]] Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop.
*May drop from Undercroft portals in the [[Duviri]] Experience while on Steel Path.

==Notes==
*[[Melee Combo|Melee combo]] is consumed every time the player swaps to a secondary with Outburst.
**This includes instances where the buff would be equal to or smaller than the current buff. 
*While the buff is active, swapping to secondary will <u>not</u> override the Outburst buff unless it would provide a higher buff than the active one.
**For example, if the current buff is '''+100%''' (swapping from a 5x combo), the arcane will not override the buff if current combo level is 5x or below when the weapon swap occurs.
**Buffs equal to or smaller than the current buff will be created, but only the largest Outburst buff at any given moment can affect gameplay. 
*Each buff expires after 30 seconds. 
**When a larger buff is created, it overrides both the value and the timer of the current buff. 
**When the buff expires, if a smaller buff exists, it will become active for the remainder of its duration.
***However, the buff is <u>not extended by buffs of the same size</u>, since the expiration of one buff will remove all Outburst buffs of that value. (e.g. Having a 10x buff, and then creating another 15 seconds into the timer will still result in both 10x buffs being removed at the expiration of the first buff's duration.)
**The UI does not reliably show the duration of the buff in situations where multiple buffs exist. Instead, it tracks the timer of the most recent buff, while displaying the value of the largest buff at the time of the most recent buff's creation. 
*The buff does not affect any of the secondary exalted weapons if the arcane is not equipped directly on secondary exalted weapons.
*It is not possible to consume combo count from both a normal and exalted melee simultaneously, only whichever is currently active.
*The {{Weapon|Venka Prime}}'s increased maximum combo count works with this arcane, allowing for a slightly larger buff than is possible with other melee weapons.
*On the other hand, the {{Weapon|Dex Nikana}}'s reduced maximum combo count also works with this arcane, allowing for a slightly weaker buff but much easier to achieve (121 combo count for 220% vs 240 for regular weapons for 240%), especially with initial combo bonus.
*The values are additive with mods like {{M|Pistol Gambit}} and {{M|Target Cracker}}.

== Tips ==
*Works extremely well with melee weapons that have modified [[Melee Combo#Initial_Combo|Initial Combo]].
**{{M|Corrupt Charge}} and especially {{M|Galvanized Reflex}} can increase Initial Combo. 
**[[Incarnon]] melees often have Initial Combo perks, as well has offering mobility buffs when transformed at 6x combo or above. 
*A 12x Initial Combo can be obtained through {{Arcane|Melee Crescendo}}, which is easily stacked by opening enemies to [[Finisher#Ground Finisher|ground finishers]] with [[ragdoll]] grouping from [[Vazarin#Void Snare|Void Snare]], {{A|Airburst}}, {{A|Coil Horizon}}, {{A|Pull}}, etc.
**All daggers can open enemies to a front/back finisher by using the forced proc of a Heavy Attack, in addition to having access to {{M|Covert Lethality}}.
*{{Weapon|Ceramic Dagger|Ceramic Dagger Incarnon}}'s '''Gun and Blade''' perk can stack up to 100x Initial Combo.

== Bugs ==

* Still incorrectly provides the buff, again only for Clients, and seemingly only when using Gunblades. Specifically, {{Weapon|Vastilok}} and {{Weapon|Redeemer Prime}} were used in testing.
* The buff activates when swapping to your secondary in the [[Arsenal]] while the player has an equipped melee weapon with any [[Melee Combo#Initial Combo|initial combo]]. 
* The game only applies and updates the UI for the largest buff value, but still creates smaller value buffs every time a secondary weapon swap occurs.
** For example, if the arcane triggers at 4x while a 10x buff is active, Outburst will still create a buff for the 4x instance, without any UI elements updating. After the 10x buff expires, the next largest buff, the 4x buff, will be active on the weapon until it expires. 
* Due to a UI bug, each time that the player swaps to the Outburst weapon without creating a new buff, the current buff is incorrectly shown to be extended at its current value.
** Ex: 10x buff is active, and a swap slightly later occurs at 4x. The UI will show that the 10x buff (200% value) has been refreshed for the full 30 seconds, even though it has not been refreshed. The UI is now tracking the timer of the 4x buff (80% value), and at the 10x value. At this point the 10x buff is not tracked despite being the active buff, and it will expire earlier than the UI indicates.

{{ArcaneBox}}'''Secondary Enervate''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for Secondary Weapons that increases [[Critical Hit#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]] on hit, resetting after a certain number of [[Critical Hit#Critical Tiers|Big Critical Hits]]. ==Effect== {| class="emodtable" |- !Rank !Critical Chance Increase !Big Critical Hit Reset |- |0||10% |1 |- |1||10% |2 |- |2||10% |3 |- |3||10% |4 |- |4||10% |5 |- |5||10% |6 |- |} {{Acquisition|*Can be bought from [[Eleanor]] of {{Faction|The Hex}} for {{sc|7,500}} at '''Rank 5 - Pizza Party'''. *Rewarded from the [[1999 Calendar]]. *Rewarded from Techrot Safes in [[Höllvania]] missions. *Rewarded from Scaldra Caches in Höllvania [[Exterminate]] missions. *Dropped by the {{E|H-09 Efervon Tank}} in Höllvania [[Assassination]] missions. *Rewarded from Höllvania [[Faceoff]] missions. *Dropped by the {{E|Scaldra Screamer}} in Höllvania [[Stage Defense]] missions.}} ==Notes== *Critical chance is an absolute bonus. While this can build the critical chance bonus to extreme levels, the burden of preparation still outweighs the benefit as the bonus will eventually reset. *Damage dealt by expiring {{D|Blast}} procs counts as a hit. **{{D|Blast}} proc explosions that occur when reaching maximum stacks or killing the target '''do not''' count as a hit. *The average final crit chance (AFCC) over a large number of shots, with the modded crit chance of the weapon being x% (and including additional bonuses such as {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}}), will be: : AFCC(x) = \begin{cases} 102.45 + 0.5x,\; & x < 110 \\ 128.8 - 0.0075x + 0.00244x^{2},\; & 110 \leq x < 140 \\ 77.5 + 0.7x,\; & 140 \leq x < 150 \\ 70 + 0.75x,\; & 150 \leq x < 160 \\ 62 + 0.8x,\; & 160 \leq x < 170 \\ 53.5 + 0.85x,\; & 170 \leq x < 180 \\ 44.5 + 0.9x,\; & 180 \leq x < 190 \\ 35 + 0.95x,\; & 190 \leq x < 200 \\ 25 + x,\; & x \geq 200 \end{cases} *AFCC values are accurate within a 0.1% up to 140% modded crit chance, and exact from 140% onwards. ==Acquisition==
*Can be bought from [[Roathe]] at [[La Cathédrale]] in the [[Sanctum Anatomica]] for 5 {{Resource|Maphica}}.
*May appear as a [[Steel Path]] [[The Descendia]] reward on a weekly rotational basis.
**Infernum 6 and 13 awards 1.
**Infernum 20 awards 3.

== Notes ==
*Only direct hits spread to nearby enemies.
**Includes secondary hits, such as split beams from {{Weapon|Tenet Cycron}} and bullet ricochet from {{Resource|Sicarus Incarnon Genesis}}.
**Additional shots from [[Multishot]] will not apply additional hits but will instead be multiplied by the multishot
***Status effects spread by this will also be multiplied by multishot even if only 1 actually procced a status effect.
*Spread hits from projectile weapons are inconsistent an differ depending on the weapon.
**For example: The {{Weapon|Epitaph Prime}} hit will only deal 84% of the original hit, while the {{Weapon|Kuva Seer}} will deal 260%
*Spread hits require '''[[line of sight]]''' to damage enemies.
*Spread hits can only apply 1 [[Status Effect]] per instance.
**{{M|Hemorrhage}} will bypass this if impact is shared but only once per enemy.
*Elemental mods are '''33% less effective''' on the spread hits.
*{{M|Galvanized Shot}} does '''not''' work on the spread hit.
*{{A|Xata's Whisper}} will multiply both the spread hit and the xata's hit by 2 independently from multishot.
*Spread hits count as regular body hits and calculate damage separately from the original hit.
**Cannot benefit from headshot or weakpoint multipliers, even if the original hit did.
**Will not deal spread hit damage to enemies which require hitting specific parts of their bodies, such as {{E|The Severed Warden}}, but can still apply status effects to them.
**Will roll a separate critical hit chance per enemy 
*Spread hits can proc various weapons' unique on-hit effects:
**{{Weapon|Arca Scisco}}'s Target Analysis (only sometimes procs)
**{{Weapon|Magnus Prime}} and {{Weapon|Akmagnus Prime}}'s Chamber Cascade.

== Tips ==
*Due to the nature of how the area damage effect is calculated, weapons with high fire rates and status are significantly more useful than slow firing weapons with low status chance.
* Several abilities are able to afflict enemies with {{D|Radiation}} quickly, such as {{WF|Nyx}}'s {{A|Chaos}} and {{WF|Oberon}}'s {{A|Smite}} ('''10''' stacks immediately), or Oberon's {{A|Hallowed Ground}} ('''2''' stacks per second, up to '''6''' stacks per second if multiple casts are stacked), allowing the arcane to function without needing to mod the damage type into your weapons.
